units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81:5">Gen. R. s. 81</cite> (play on <he>זמות</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 30:32">Prov. XXX, 32</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00526"><he>זָמַם</he> I</cite>) <he>אם חשבת … נוח לך ליתן ז׳ וכ׳</he> if thou hast planned to do a good deed …, it would have been better for thee to put a muzzle on thy mouth.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75:13">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> (ref. to <he>זממו</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 140:9">Ps. CXL, 9</cite>) <he>עשה לו ז׳ וכ׳</he> put a bit to Esaw (Rome); … <he>ומהו ז׳ וכ׳</he> and what is the bit (to check Rome’s power) &c.?; <cite ref="Megillah 6a:7">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>זְמָמוֹ אל תפק וכ׳</he> ‘do not loosen his bit’ (Ps. l. c.), that means Germania &c.—Pl. <he>זְמָמִים</he>, v. <cite ref="G00507"><he>זְמוּם</he></cite>.
